integrity: All stated formulas follow from the written structural proof; finite brute force corroborates but does not replace it. Self-review only. No independent review or bibliographic priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to cycles of order at least five with positive private-clique orders; excludes small cycle cores, arbitrary nonclique attachments and shortest-path general position. Exhaustive verification covers finitely many instances only. Priority could be affected by unindexed literature.
title: Complete monophonic-position and facet polynomials of cycles with private cliques
